<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-2413-54-04" status="unreviewed">dang po 'di <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3839">kha 1</rs>
               <lb n="45b8"/>na re sgra tsam chos can mi rtag pa khyab byed du yod de rtsol byung rten tsam du yod pa'i phyir ces bkod pa de chos can gyi phyogs 1 la ma grub pa'i skyon can yin te | de yang mi rtag pa khyab byed du sgrub ma nus pas rtags skyon can ni yin rtsol byung la mi rtag pas khyab pa tshang bas rtsol byung de chu sgra brag sgra laso pa sgra'i phyogs 1 la ma grub pas lan
               <lb n="45b9"/>pa yin la mang sgra mi rtag par grub pa la byas pa tsam ldog rtags su bgkod pa'i she rtags kyi phyogs ta chos can la ma grub pa yi ne snya'i byas pa grub kyag sra ba yin gyi byas pa ma grub pa'i phyir ce ste | 'di dgag pa la re || khyab pa skyon med yin pa dgag pa dang | phyogs chos skyon can yin pa dgag pa'o ||</seg></TEI>
